run_release_notes_pipeline: run the release notes generation pipeline for a given git tag and version bump type
bump_version_tag: bump a semver version tag by major, minor, or patch level
run_opencode_skill: run an OpenCode skill to generate or validate release notes from PR files
check_opencode_model: check that an OpenCode model is available before running the release notes pipeline
validate_release_notes: validate release notes against the PR manifest to find missing or extra PRs
